state.background: Review the implementation against results/plan46/phase6/chromium-unsplit-efficient-order-plan-2026-09-29.md. The change does not claim to reduce total suite runtime; timings are a single older sample and exclude file setup. The plan review result is separately recorded as valid_as_defined.
